summary: Frontend-only testing of the new alarm sound feature for OverdueAlertModal + Settings 'Alarm' tab. All 12 test scenarios PASSED: alarm tab selectors, preset selection + localStorage persistence across close/reopen, volume slider (30% -> 0.3), enable toggle, custom sound upload (tiny valid WAV) with auto-select + remove/preview buttons, remove-custom flow (fallback to two_tone), 2 MB size limit rejection with toast, non-audio MIME rejection with toast, preview buttons producing no JS console errors, regression on other Settings tabs (Renkler/Temalar/Hesap) working, and settings-close working. No overdue tasks appeared for 'serkan' during test window so OverdueAlertModal visibility itself was not asserted, but no JS errors were emitted from the imported playAlarm/stopAlarm in the modal file, and no console errors occurred anywhere during the run.
critical_code_review_comments: alarmSounds.js: playCustomFromDataUrl creates a fresh new Audio(dataUrl) each call but stopAlarm() only pauses activeHtmlAudio — WebAudio preset playback runs on its own AudioContext and is NOT stopped by stopAlarm(). If a preset (e.g. bell 1.4s) is playing and user opens Settings again (which calls stopAlarm()), the WebAudio preset keeps playing. Consider tracking preset AudioContexts so stopAlarm() closes them too. Low priority, does not break tests.

alarmSounds.js: The 2 MB limit check lives in SettingsPanel.jsx (frontend size check) but saveCustomAlarm's localStorage quota fallback throws a generic 'çok büyük' error — since base64 inflates 33%, a file just under 2 MB (~1.9MB) could still throw when combined with other localStorage keys near the ~5MB browser quota. Consider lowering client-side limit to ~1.5 MB or catching QuotaExceededError with a clearer message.

OverdueAlertModal.jsx line 92-96: isNew detection re-triggers playAlarm() every poll (every 30s) if a new overdue task appears — intentional, but if backend clock skews and returns brief 'overdue' flickers, users could get repeated beeps. Consider a min-cooldown between plays.
seed_data_creation: None. Tiny WAV (44-byte header + 8 samples) and 3 MB WAV generated in /tmp for upload validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Alarm tab lives in Settings modal between Temalar and Hesap. testids: alarm-tab-content, alarm-preset-{two_tone|classic|scifi|bell|digital|custom}, alarm-preview-{...}, alarm-toggle-enabled, alarm-upload-btn, alarm-file-input (hidden, use set_input_files), alarm-volume-slider, alarm-preview-current, alarm-preview-custom (only when custom loaded), alarm-remove-custom (only when custom loaded). LocalStorage keys: sertex_alarm_settings_v1 { selected, volume, enabled }, sertex_alarm_custom_v1 { name, dataUrl }. Toast text 'ses dosyası' triggers on non-audio, '2 MB' triggers on oversized. WebAudio preset autoplay is allowed in headless because click gestures are simulated. Full 12-scenario browser flow passed with zero console errors.
